about_the_game:
A Music-Powered Planet, UCISMA

「Music is the lifeblood of this planet, formed by the fusion of Rhythm, Melody, and Harmony.」

UCISMA is a top-down rhythm action game where players move in sync with the beat. One day, Music vanished from the music-powered planet Ucisma due to the loss of three Absolute Artifacts. To restore it, the Supreme Elder took up the legendary sword.

Now you, as the Supreme Elder, embark on a journey to reclaim Music. Move dynamically to each stage’s rhythm and purify Ucisma!

How To Play

Attack: Left-click on mouse

Dash: Right-click on mouse

Move: WASD

Game Description

- This game is a rhythm action top view game.

- Use the mouse for non-game menus.

- Each stage has different background music and hazards.

- You have to operate to the beat and survive until the music is over.

- If the stage is successful, the next stage will be opened.

Additional Description

- The length of the music varies from stage to stage, usually around a minute or two.

- The higher the score, the better the stage rating.

- You can read the story with the book-shaped icon at the bottom of the stage selection.

Etc.

Tutorial play and random line description right before entering the stage, will go a long way towards gameplay!

(The 'HOW TO PLAY' button on the main screen enters the tutorial)
